result_text:
`PromotionService.createPromotion` now trims the code before it does anything else with it. That trimmed code is used for the duplicate check and for the stored promotion. I added the single line `code = code.trim();` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/service/PromotionService.java`, right after the blank-code check.

So "  SPRING10 " is stored and shown as SPRING10, and lookup by SPRING10 finds it. Creating SPRING10 again, with or without spaces, is rejected as a duplicate.

I ran the `*Promotion*` tests and they pass. I didn't add a new test for the whitespace case.

Lookups by code (such as `limitToRegion`) are unchanged, so a lookup passing spaces still finds nothing. I left that alone because the task only covers setting up the promotion.
